layers.rule: Digitized polygons mark approximate agricultural plots; they do not establish cadastral ownership or legal chiban.
Separate managed coastal wetlands CO2 pools and non-CO2 CH4/N2O pathways; emissions method not interchangeable with JBE project credit certification.

Uncertainty inputs include sampling, measurement, missingness and representativeness. National FY2024 net emissions approximately -3%/+2%; agriculture approx -10%/+22% (rounded), not a field-level AG005 confidence interval.

Sec 5.5 addresses methane emissions from rice cultivation, including tier choice, emission/scaling factors, activity data and illustrative calculations. Not automatically the current Japanese J-Credit AG005 rules.

QC includes calculation, unit, completeness, time series, record-keeping, trend checking and documented assumptions. Separate independent QAWG peer review is QA; NaFT running unit tests does not establish external QA.
MoE guide frames habitat seagrass/tidal-flat restoration, baseline surveys, monitoring and co-benefits; do not infer a certified blue carbon quantity from ecological indicators alone.

AG-005 v3.3 references eMAFF農地ナビ 所在・地番 for 2025-01-01+ activities even when prior project registered under v1.0–3.1; fallback to area-document chiban if absent only with evidence such as screenshot. One-to-many spatial case handling requires human reconciliation.

uncertainty_interpretation: The country inventory's uncertainties are not transferable to an individual rice plot or BlueCarbon credit without validated statistical model and local measurement data.
qa_interpretation: Internal code test success is QC at best; authoritative external review and legal certification remain separate.
